content.title: WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026: Start Time & Where to Watch
content.text: Streaming info for NXT Stand & Deliver, their biggest show of the year.Apr 4, 2026 2:06 PM EDTJoe Hendry will defend the NXT Championship in a 4-Way at Stand & Deliver.Getty Images WWE NXT’s major annual event, Stand & Deliver, streams tonight on WWE’s YouTube channel. This marks the first time an NXT event will stream on YouTube, following the expiration of WWE’s deal with Peacock. WWE has seen tremendous success with this format for AAA, and it’s projected that tonight’s event will be the highest-streamed NXT event ever. WWE Hall of Famer Shawn Michaels has put together a can’t-miss card for tonight’s event. No longer part of WrestleMania weekend, the stars of NXT have a real opportunity to shine on their own. Here is the full card and official start of NXT Stand & Deliver 2026. Blake Monroe will challenge Tatum Paxley for the NXT Women’s North American Championship, though she stole the actual title.Getty Images The show will officially begin at 7 pm ET / 4 pm PT. The countdown show will start one hour prior at 6 pm ET. What Matches Will Take Place at Stand & Deliver? Ricky Saints looks to become a 2-time NXT Champion at Stand & Deliver.Getty Images There are seven matches advertised for Stand & Deliver, six of them being championship matches. NXT Championship — Fatal 4-Way MatchJoe Hendry (c) vs. Ethan Page vs. Ricky Saints vs. Tony D’Angelo NXT Women’s Championship — Triple Threat MatchJacy Jane (c) vs. Kendal Grey vs. Lola Vice NXT Women’s North American ChampionshipTatum Paxley (c) vs. Blake Monroe NXT North American ChampionshipMyles Borne (c) vs. Johnny Gargano NXT Tag Team ChampionshipsThe Vanity Project (c) vs. Los Americanos Singles MatchSol Ruca (c) vs. Zaria 10-Person Mixed Tag Team MatchHank & Tank, Shiloh Hill, EK Prosper and Wren Sinclair vs. Birth Right Special AppearanceRap star Sexxy Red is advertised to appear on the show.
